description: Remove photos from a regular collection; catalog and other memberships stay. Returns removed (unique members) and not_in_collection (photo_ids that were not members); unknown IDs are not_found.

collection_name.description: Collection path from list_collections, or a bare name. A listed path always picks that collection; a bare name of a nested collection must be unique.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

name: remove_from_collection
title: Remove from collection
